Every help page in the package. The grouping below is the one the reference
index used to have; an alphabetical list of the same pages follows.

**Connecting.** Opening a database, optionally straight onto a branch. `dbConnect()` takes the DoltLite-specific `branch`, `bigint` and `busy_timeout` arguments alongside the usual DBI ones.

[Doltlite()](manual/doltlite.html), [dbConnect()](manual/dbconnect-doltlitedriver-method.html), [DOLTLITE_RO](manual/doltlite-ro.html)

**DBI classes and methods.** The ordinary DBI surface. These behave as they would for any SQLite database, with the documented exceptions around clustered primary keys and transactions.

[dbWriteTable()](manual/dbwritetable-doltliteconnection-character-data-frame-method.html), [dbDataType()](manual/dbdatatype-doltlitedriver-method.html), [doltliter-transactions](manual/doltliter-transactions.html)

**Configuring and committing.** The commit loop. Note that `dolt_commit()` is the *Dolt* sense of commit -- it writes to the version history -- and is unrelated to `DBI::dbCommit()`.

[dolt_config()](manual/dolt-config.html), [dolt_add()](manual/dolt-add.html), [dolt_commit()](manual/dolt-commit.html), [dolt_status()](manual/dolt-status.html), [dolt_reset()](manual/dolt-reset.html), [dolt_revert()](manual/dolt-revert.html), [dolt_cherry_pick()](manual/dolt-cherry-pick.html)

**Branches, merging and conflicts.** Each connection selects its own branch. Conflicts exist only inside the transaction that produced them, so a merge you expect to conflict belongs in one.

[dolt_branch()](manual/dolt-branch.html), [dolt_checkout()](manual/dolt-checkout.html), [dolt_active_branch()](manual/dolt-active-branch.html), [dolt_merge()](manual/dolt-merge.html), [dolt_merge_base()](manual/dolt-merge-base.html), [dolt_merge_status()](manual/dolt-merge-status.html), [dolt_rebase()](manual/dolt-rebase.html), [dolt_tag()](manual/dolt-tag.html), [dolt_conflicts()](manual/dolt-conflicts.html), [dolt_constraint_violations()](manual/dolt-constraint-violations.html)

**History, diffs and time travel.** Reading the past: what changed, when, and who changed it.

[dolt_log()](manual/dolt-log.html), [dolt_diff()](manual/dolt-diff.html), [dolt_table_diff()](manual/dolt-table-diff.html), [dolt_diff_stat()](manual/dolt-diff-stat.html), [dolt_patch()](manual/dolt-patch.html), [dolt_history()](manual/dolt-history.html), [dolt_at()](manual/dolt-at.html), [dolt_blame()](manual/dolt-blame.html), [dolt_workspace()](manual/dolt-workspace.html), [dolt_schemas()](manual/dolt-schemas.html)

**Remotes.** Pushing and pulling between databases, over the filesystem or HTTP.

[dolt_remote()](manual/dolt-remote.html), [dolt_push()](manual/dolt-push.html), [dolt_pull()](manual/dolt-pull.html), [dolt_clone()](manual/dolt-clone.html), [dolt_creds()](manual/dolt-creds.html)

**Interactive.** A Shiny gadget and RStudio addin over a connection you already have open.

[dolt_pane()](manual/dolt-pane.html)

**Introspection and maintenance.** Content hashes, versions and housekeeping.

[dolt_hashof()](manual/dolt-hashof.html), [dolt_version()](manual/dolt-version.html), [doltlite_engine()](manual/doltlite-engine.html), [dolt_gc()](manual/dolt-gc.html), [dolt_verify_constraints()](manual/dolt-verify-constraints.html)

**Calling anything else.** The two escape hatches for DoltLite functions this package does not wrap, with arguments bound as parameters rather than pasted into SQL.

[dolt_scalar()](manual/dolt-scalar.html), [dolt_table()](manual/dolt-table.html)
